'''Boaz''' was a member of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Not long after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was part of a team sent to recover the stolen experimental starship known as the ''[[Staraker]]'', which they followed to the [[Alashan system/Legends|Alashan system]]. A [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] fired from the surface forced the ''Staraker'' to crash-land on [[Alashan]], and also destroyed the main [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessel. Boaz and his team came in before the cruiser in a smaller craft and landed on Alashan, surviving the destruction of the cruiser.<ref name="Unholy Alliance!" />

The team met with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on the surface of Alashan and decided to work together to investigate the source of the superlaser. Boaz broke his leg in an avalanche caused by the superlaser firing at a nearby mountain, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Kyril Lopaki]] refused to come to his aid in order to save himself.<ref name="Unholy Alliance!" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boaz appeared in ''[[Unholy Alliance!]]'', the second part of ''[[The Word for World is Death!]]'' comic series, which was published in April 1980.
